ticket.title: handoff events sort at timestamp zero, so records replay disagrees with ledger order
ticket.description: event_timestamp reads the clock from the payload for task_created, deferred_item_captured, task_verified and task_claimed, but HandoffRecorded falls through to timestamp_of, whose final arm returns 0. Every handoff therefore sorts ahead of all real events no matter when it happened, even though the handoff payload carries timestamp_ms and the doc comment promises that no event sorts at zero by accident. Measured on colinwolff.dev while migrating a legacy ledger store (CW-88 there): CW-71 was claimed at 1793748147488 and handed off to ready at 1793748365120, 216 seconds later. Replay from the ledger ends ready; replay by (timestamp, task_id) ends in_progress, so storypole migrate aborts with a divergence error and, worse, leaves a written record whose status is wrong. Any store with a handed-off ticket that was never subsequently verified cannot be migrated.
acceptance_criteria: event_timestamp returns handoff.timestamp_ms for HandoffRecorded and no variant sorts at zero unless its payload says so
a regression test replays claim-then-handoff and asserts the handoff wins by timestamp
cargo fmt, clippy with -D warnings and the storypole-core test suite pass

plan.summary: Read the handoff packet clock instead of sorting it at zero, so records replay agrees with legacy ledger order and migrate stops aborting.

# SP-54 - order a handoff by its own clock

## Intent
A handoff must sort by when it was recorded, so records replay agrees with a legacy ledger's file
order and `migrate` can archive that ledger.

## Steps
1. Read `HandoffRecorded` from `handoff.timestamp_ms` in `tickets::order::timestamp_of`.
   Gate: `cargo test -p storypole-core --lib order_tests`
2. Pin it with a regression test that fails when the arm returns zero.
   Gate: mutation check, then `cargo test -p storypole-core`
3. Keep the crate gates clean.
   Gate: `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` rc=0

steps.title: Pin with a regression test that fails on zero
steps.verification_gate: mutation check then full crate tests
